description: Class A - CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE (design section 3 Class A). The arena path of BufferCache::DownloadMemory records a vk::BufferMemoryBarrier2 inside an open dynamic-rendering instance (illegal without dynamicRenderingLocalRead; VUID 09553/09554), so the producer/consumer ordering it guards is not honored and the transfer/BDA read can observe stale arena data -> disappearing geometry/effects in #29/#30. Fix is a placement correction plus the renpass-barrier regression test. Independent of FEAT-003/004; must land before FEAT-003 because FEAT-003 extends this test file.
steps: In gpu/shadps4/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.cpp, in BufferCache::DownloadMemory (the arena path), insert 'scheduler.EndRendering();' immediately before the scheduler.Record(...) block that emits pre_barrier (the pipelineBarrier2 call is at ~line 482, before runtime.CopyBuffer(arena, download.buffer, copies) at ~line 488). Keep the barrier's srcStageMask/srcAccessMask/dstStageMask/dstAccessMask unchanged - placement fix only, matching the correct sibling at ~lines 841-842 (EndRendering before CopyBuffer). Do NOT enable dynamicRenderingLocalRead and do NOT change the barrier scope.

Create tests/test_renderpass_barrier.cpp modelled on tests/test_dma_barriers.cpp (reuse tests/test_dma_runtime_stubs.cpp, or add a sibling stub file if link symbols differ): construct Instance(-1, false) with validation enabled (or install a VK debug-utils callback) and a counter that increments on VUID-vkCmdPipelineBarrier2-None-09553 and -09554; open a dynamic-rendering instance via scheduler.BeginRendering(state) (reuse blit_helper-style state), map a guest range + ObtainBuffer + mark GPU-modified, trigger BufferCache::DownloadMemory on that arena, scheduler.Finish(), then assert the 09553/09554 counter == 0. If no Vulkan device is available, print 'no device' and exit 0 (skip cleanly).

Register the test: add 'renderpass-barrier' to the tests=(...) array in tools/run_tests.sh, and add an add_executable(renderpass-barrier-test EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ../tests/test_renderpass_barrier.cpp ../tests/test_dma_runtime_stubs.cpp) entry in gpu/CMakeLists.txt mirroring dma-barriers-test (target_include_directories ... shim shadps4 third_party/gcn/include; target_compile_definitions ... NDEBUG; target_link_libraries ... theordergpu; the WIN32 compat_win.c + onecore block).
acceptance_criteria: BufferCache::DownloadMemory arena path calls scheduler.EndRendering() before recording the pre_barrier, so no buffer barrier is emitted inside an open render pass.
renderpass-barrier-test is registered in both tools/run_tests.sh and gpu/CMakeLists.txt and its Class A assertion passes with the fix.
Reverting the EndRendering insertion makes the Class A assertion FAIL on a device (red-without-fix demonstrated).
verification: Red/green: with the fix, ninja -C out/gpu renderpass-barrier-test && out/gpu/renderpass-barrier-test passes the Class A assertion; temporarily reverting step 1 makes it fail (on a device).
Full suite: tools/run_tests.sh prints the all-pass line.
Runtime (non-blocking repro per context.json): VUID-vkCmdPipelineBarrier2-None-09553 and -09554 counts drop to 0 in the validation log.
findings:
Fix landed: buffer_cache.cpp DownloadMemory arena path now calls scheduler.EndRendering() immediately before the scheduler.Record(...) block that emits pre_barrier (buffer_cache.cpp ~:476, before runtime.CopyBuffer). Barrier src/dst stage+access masks and scope are UNCHANGED; dynamicRenderingLocalRead NOT enabled. Mirrors the sibling EndRendering-before-CopyBuffer in ReadEdgeImagePages.

Regression test: tests/test_renderpass_barrier.cpp (new) + tests/test_renderpass_runtime_stubs.cpp (new sibling stub). I could NOT reuse tests/test_dma_runtime_stubs.cpp directly: the arena sync download reaches MemoryManager::TryWriteBacking -> runtime_memory_write_backing, which the shared test_gpu_runtime_stubs.cpp aborts in (std::abort). The new stub no-ops runtime_memory_write_backing (returns size) so the download completes; otherwise it mirrors the DMA stub. If FEAT-003 extends test_renderpass_barrier.cpp, link it against test_renderpass_runtime_stubs.cpp (NOT test_dma_runtime_stubs.cpp) for the same reason.

Test mechanism: Instance(-1, true) with validation; the test installs a SECOND VkDebugUtilsMessenger (via instance.GetInstance().createDebugUtilsMessengerEXTUnique) whose callback counts VUID-vkCmdPipelineBarrier2-None-09553 and -09554 into an atomic; it opens an attachment-less dynamic-rendering instance (RenderState{} with num_color_attachments=0) via scheduler.BeginRendering, makes the arena resident (ObtainBuffer+InvalidateMemory+SynchronizeDmaBuffers+Finish), MarkRegionAsGpuModified, then drives the arena DownloadMemory via buffers.ReadMemory(addr,size,false,false,/*assume_locks=*/true) (liverpool is null, so assume_locks runs flush_request synchronously), scheduler.Finish(), and asserts the 09553/09554 count == 0. Skips cleanly (exit 0) if the debug messenger can't be created.

Red/green verified on the NVIDIA RTX 5060 dev device: with the fix, exit 0 and 'renderpass-barrier: arena download barrier recorded outside the render pass (09553/09554 count = 0)'. Reverting the EndRendering line makes the validation layer fire BOTH VUID-09553 and -09554 (counter=2) and the assertion fails (abort, exit 127) -- red-without-fix demonstrated.

Registration: 'renderpass-barrier' added to tools/run_tests.sh tests=(...) and add_executable(renderpass-barrier-test EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ../tests/test_renderpass_barrier.cpp ../tests/test_renderpass_runtime_stubs.cpp) added in gpu/CMakeLists.txt mirroring dma-barriers-test (include dirs shim/shadps4/gcn, NDEBUG, link theordergpu, WIN32 compat_win.c + onecore).

Full suite: all 44 C/C++ tests pass (run_tests.sh). The ONLY failure is the pre-existing, unrelated Python test test_launcher_controls.ReleaseVersionTest.test_the_order_release_version, which asserts launcher.VERSION=='0.7.2' while the build is 0.7.3 (version-string staleness; untouched by this FEAT, no launcher/version files changed).

Build note for later steps: out/gpu is a Ninja tree configured against drive W: (subst W: C:\projetos\fork\theorder1886-port\.worktrees\flicker-rca). Re-run `subst W: <worktree>` before building, then build/run tests from /w inside MSYSTEM=CLANG64 bash. Benign teardown note VUID-vkDestroyDevice-device-05137 (leaked arena DeviceMemory) appears at headless-test exit and does not affect the counted VUIDs or exit code.

Runtime non-blocking probe (per context.json) was NOT run for this FEAT: the Class A defect is deterministically reproduced and fixed by the registered regression test (red->green on the matching NVIDIA device), so a frame-dump probe was unnecessary to prove the 09553/09554 counts drop to 0. A later integration/validation step can still run the non-blocking run.py probe to confirm in-game.
